[NTST.8.1] `ds_engine_load_dsc` consumes a byte slice that
contains a compiled `.dsc`. For tests, integrators
typically:

- Pre-build a known-good `.dsc` against test fixture
  source (compiled once, committed to the test tree).
- Load it during test setup and verify it registers the
  schemas / rules you expect by querying
  `ds_engine_schema_count`, `ds_engine_schema_find`,
  `ds_engine_rule_meta_find`.
